name: Ferienwohnung Hotter Neu Fleck
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in the health resort of Bad Haering with scenic views, Ferienwohnung Hotter Neu Fleck offers cosy living spaces for holidaymakers. The well-equipped apartment features bright rooms and an inviting balcony.

The spa gardens, healing sulphur springs, and walking trails across the Tyrolean Inn Valley are nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Hotter Neu Fleck in Bad Haering provides sunny holiday living on the high plateau of Kufsteinerland.
